title: Compatible derived evaluations lift to a strict derived tower map
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site and $R$ a sheaf of rings. Set $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $\mathcal B=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal A)$ [lem-weil-pbc-small-module-diagrams-grothendieck], with levelwise exactness. Derived categories are [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For $X,Y\in D(\mathcal B)$, write $X_n,Y_n$ for their derived evaluations and $t^X_n:X_{n+1}\to X_n$, $t^Y_n:Y_{n+1}\to Y_n$ for their transitions. Every family $f_n:X_n\to Y_n$ in $D(\mathcal A)$ satisfying $t^Y_nf_{n+1}=f_nt^X_n$ admits a lift $f:X\to Y$ in $D(\mathcal B)$ whose derived evaluations are the $f_n$. A lift is an isomorphism if every $f_n$ is an isomorphism. Neither uniqueness of the lift nor a functorial choice of lifts is asserted.
